namespaces.recommended_strategy: compatibility reader first: read legacy flag and new Frame Conn-owned SITREP state; once new representation is stable, migrate/write through a single canonical service
move ownership to foundry_features/elevation_los and preserve a legacy read path until existing worlds can be migrated
safe to intentionally abandon when replacing the legacy HUD unless preserving window position/minimized state is desired

public_globals.recommended_strategy: replace with runtime-orchestrator-composed Frame Conn public API or no public global if unnecessary
replace with a registered foundry_features API surfaced through Frame Conn composition only if external access is actually needed

namespace_policy: Do not rename legacy persisted flags until a compatibility/migration strategy exists.
New SITREP code must have one canonical state service rather than scattered direct getFlag/setFlag calls.
New Foundry elevation/LOS code must not remain under a SITREP-owned namespace indefinitely.
Public game.* APIs must be composed intentionally by the authoritative Frame Conn runtime rather than assigned by feature modules.
